items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: he got Lawrence Brown to ...(?)... The next time, I was in Boston, and he asked me about coming with the band, and I said, 'Okay' -- you know, because Lawrence was leaving. But Lawrence decided to stay, so I didn't go again.

ctx.x: I always felt that you might have been very good in the Ellington band. Was there ever anything about that...?

Sort of once. Maybe a couple of times. Well, before Lawrence joined the band, in Indianapolis, Johnny and...uh...Freddy Jenkins... I was playing in Indianapolis, and they came to Indianapolis. And at this time, I wasn't working, but I went to a jam session; you know, jams...a sit-in thing. And they brought Duke in to hear me. And I was juiced back, so I... [LAUGHS] So right after that, he got Lawrence Brown to ...(?)... The next time, I was in Boston, and he asked me about coming with the band, and I said, "Okay"…
